signatureEngine.name: 拘缚者
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 束缚枷锁
refinements.description: 攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击]造成的伤害和失衡值提升6%，最多叠加5层，持续8秒，同一招式内最多触发一次，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from Basic Attacks increase by 6% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 束缚枷锁
refinements.description: 攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击]造成的伤害和失衡值提升7.5%，最多叠加5层，持续8秒，同一招式内最多触发一次，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from Basic Attacks increase by 7.5% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 束缚枷锁
refinements.description: 攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击]造成的伤害和失衡值提升9%，最多叠加5层，持续8秒，同一招式内最多触发一次，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from Basic Attacks increase by 9% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 束缚枷锁
refinements.description: 攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击]造成的伤害和失衡值提升10.5%，最多叠加5层，持续8秒，同一招式内最多触发一次，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from Basic Attacks increase by 10.5% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 束缚枷锁
refinements.description: 攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击]造成的伤害和失衡值提升12%，最多叠加5层，持续8秒，同一招式内最多触发一次，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from Basic Attacks increase by 12% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

basic.name: 普通攻击：狩月舞步
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害；
长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力，并造成冰属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold down [Basic Attack] to charge up, increasing the power of the attack and dealing Ice DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：追猎时刻
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行连续打击，造成冰属性伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Hold down [Special Attack] to charge up, increasing its power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：狂猎时刻
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，消耗能量并提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Hold down [EX Special Attack] to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：礼仪教导
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：遵命
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes at enemies in a small area in front of him, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：不辱使命
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes multiple powerful strikes at enemies in a large area, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：狼群
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：狩猎干预
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：复仇反扑
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
在前方生成冰柱并对区域内的敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Creates an icicle in front, which strikes all enemies within range, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力时，招式造成的失衡值提升80%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]或[支援突击：复仇反扑]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，持续30秒。
facts.textEn:
When Lycaon charges his Basic Attack to completion, the attack deals 80% increased Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack hits an enemy, the target's Ice DMG RES decreases by 25% for 30s.

cinema.name: 满月蓄势
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]命中敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升12%，8秒内最多触发一次；在[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]中完成蓄力时，该增益效果额外提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lycaon's EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.

cinema.name: 能量回馈
cinema.description: 使敌人失衡或触发队友的[连携技]时，莱卡恩回复5点能量，1秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's Chain Attack, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.

cinema.name: 执事教养
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 保持风度
cinema.description:
在[普通攻击]或[特殊技]的发动期间受到敌方攻击时，
莱卡恩立刻获得等同于自身7.5%生命值上限的护盾，持续15秒，
护盾持续期间抗打断等级提升，15秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn:
If Lycaon is attacked while using a Basic Attack or Special Attack, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s.
During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

cinema.name: 头狼本色
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 冷酷猎手
cinema.description: 蓄力攻击命中敌人时，莱卡恩对目标造成的伤害提升10%，最多叠加5层，持续12秒；同一招式内最多叠加1层效果，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When a charged attack hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s. Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
